method_notes: Hackney Education (home school distance page and Community Schools Admission Arrangements): home-to-school distance is measured in a straight line by a computerised distance-measuring system from the home address point (NLPG easting/northing, usually within the property footprint; one point per block of flats) to the main entrance of the school; the measuring point may not be the gate currently used. Community school oversubscription order: EHCP named, looked-after/previously looked-after, child protection plan, medical/social, siblings (community schools: if the family has moved since the sibling was offered, sibling priority only within 2 miles), children of staff, distance. Council says some schools and academies measure distance using other methods. Council tables give 'Max Distance (last child offered in miles)' only for community schools; VA schools and academies table gives applications/offers only.

gaps: Council publishes cut-off distances only for the 32 community schools; the 18 VA schools and academies have no distance in any year, so they are 'not_published' unless the table shows non-preference offers or offers below places available (then 'all_offered'). Interpretation choices: a community school with non-preference offers, or with offers below places and no cap, is recorded as 'all_offered' (the printed max distance is kept in criterion_note) because vacancies remained after all applicants were placed; Hackney has falling rolls and many undersubscribed schools. Implausible printed distances on full schools (Hoxton Garden 2026: 350.333 miles; Parkwood 2024: 350.244 miles) recorded as not_published; other 350+/180 mile values (Millfields 2024/2025, Princess May 2025, Queensbridge 2025) fell on schools with non-preference offers and are recorded as all_offered. Capped schools (Hoxton Garden, Orchard, Princess May in 2026; Mandeville/Oldhill/Orchard/Princess May/Hoxton earlier) keep the distance even when offers < PAN. PAN = 'Total Places Available' in the 2026 table. Closed schools in earlier tables (Oldhill, Sir Thomas Abney, St Dominic's, St Mary's CofE - closed Aug 2025 per GIAS or absent from 2026 table) excluded. Postcodes and types from GIAS (Oct 2026). Per-school academy/VA measurement methods not researched (method 'unknown'). Distances are as printed in miles to 3 d.p.; criterion of the last offer is not given. The column is headed 'Max Distance (last child offered in miles)'; some full schools show large values (Gainsborough 2025 8.332, London Fields 2024 6.481, Queensbridge 2026 3.517, Shoreditch Park 2024 2.304) that may be the furthest child offered under a non-distance criterion (sibling/medical) rather than a true distance cut-off - recorded as printed, unverified.
